title: Leviticus Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Leviticus 1: the laws for burnt offerings from the herd, from the flock and from the birds.

questions.text: From where did Yahweh speak to Moses at the start of Leviticus?
questions.explanation: Yahweh called to Moses and spoke to him from the Tent of Meeting.

answers.text: From the gate of the court
From the bank of the Jordan

questions.text: What kind of animal from the herd had to be offered as a burnt offering?
questions.explanation: If the burnt offering was from the herd, he had to offer a male without defect at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

answers.text: A male or female of any age
The weakest animal of the herd

questions.text: What did the offerer do with his hand so that the burnt offering would be accepted for him?
questions.explanation: He was to lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it would be accepted for him to make atonement for him.

answers.text: He dipped it in the blood
He laid it on the offering's head
He placed it on the horns of the altar

questions.text: Who presented the blood of the bull and sprinkled it around on the altar?
questions.explanation: Aaron's sons, the priests, presented the blood and sprinkled it around on the altar at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

answers.text: The man who brought the offering

questions.text: Which parts of the burnt offering from the herd were washed with water?
questions.explanation: The pieces, the head and the fat were laid on the wood, but its innards and its legs were washed with water.

questions.text: On which side of the altar was a burnt offering from the flock killed?
questions.explanation: He shall kill it on the north side of the altar before Yahweh.

questions.text: Which birds could be offered as a burnt offering?
questions.explanation: If the burnt offering was of birds, he had to offer it from turtledoves or young pigeons.

answers.text: Sparrows or swallows from the field

questions.text: Where was the blood of a bird burnt offering drained out?
questions.explanation: The priest wrung off its head and burned it on the altar, and its blood was drained out on the side of the altar.

answers.text: On the ground outside the camp
On the side of the altar
On the veil of the tent

questions.text: Where were the crop and the feathers of the bird cast?
questions.explanation: He took away its crop and its feathers and cast them beside the altar on the east part, in the place of the ashes.

answers.text: East of the altar, in the place of the ashes
Into the fire on the altar
Outside the camp, in a clean place far from the tents
At the door of the Tent of Meeting

questions.text: How was the bird to be torn before it was burned?
questions.explanation: He shall tear it by its wings, but shall not divide it apart.

answers.text: By its wings, without dividing it apart
Its wings were cut off and thrown into the fire
